title: Privacy Policy
advisory.title: Translation
advisory.body: This is a translation for convenience. Only the Italian version of this document is legally binding. Show the Italian version
intro: In short: Rootsy collects only the data strictly necessary to help you find places and communities that speak your language. The documents you upload to the Vault are end-to-end encrypted: not even we can see them. We do not sell your data to third parties.
s1.p1: Rootsy — David Rallo (Kleingewerbe in Germany). Email: hello@myrootsy.com. Domain: myrootsy.com.
s2.li2: Profile data: country of origin, current city, languages spoken, chosen cultures (provided voluntarily).
s2.li3: Documents uploaded to the Vault: end-to-end encrypted on your device before upload. The decryption key never leaves your phone/browser.
s2.li4: Usage data: searches, saved places, community confirmations (to improve the service).
s2.li5: Technical data: IP address, browser, operating system (for security and abuse prevention).
s3.p1: Religion and other sensitive data are optional and are collected only if you voluntarily choose to share them in order to filter places of worship. You can remove them from your profile at any time.
s4.li1: To provide you with the Rootsy service (map, community, Expat Mode).
s4.li2: To personalise suggestions based on your language and culture.
s4.li3: To send you document expiry notifications (only if you have turned them on).
s4.li4: To improve the product in aggregated and anonymous form.
s5.p1: We process your data on the basis of: (a) consent for optional features (culture, religion, notifications), (b) performance of a contract for the core service, (c) legitimate interests for security and fraud prevention.
s6.p1: Your personal data is never sold. It may be shared only with the technical providers that help us run the service:
s6.li2: Google Cloud / Vertex AI (Gemini AI engine for the assistant)
s6.p2: All of them operate under GDPR-compliant data processing agreements (DPAs).
s7.p1: Where providers are based in the USA (Google, Stripe), we use the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
s8.p1: We keep your data for as long as necessary to provide you with the service. When you delete your account, your personal data is erased within 30 days (with exceptions required by law for invoices and tax obligations).
s9.li1: Access: request a copy of your data.
s9.li2: Rectification: correct inaccurate data from your profile or by writing to us.
s9.li3: Erasure: the “right to be forgotten” — ask for your data to be removed entirely.
s9.li4: Data portability: export your data in a readable format.
s9.li5: Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interests.
s9.li6: Complaint: lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority of your country (e.g. Garante.it in Italy, BfDI in Germany).
s9.p1: To exercise any of these rights: hello@myrootsy.com.
s10.p1: We adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures: encryption in transit (TLS 1.3), Row Level Security on the database, passwords hashed with bcrypt, audit logs of administrative access, 2FA for staff accounts.
s11.p1: We use only essential technical cookies and localStorage to store your preferences (language, cultures). See the Cookie Policy for details.
s12.p1: We will notify you by email at least 30 days before any substantial changes to this policy.
s13.p1:
Data Protection Officer (DPO) email: hello@myrootsy.com
Postal address: provided on request by email.
